lines.text: Gather round, kids, and let me tell you
about the fastest rabbit in the whole forest.
He loved bragging to the little turtle,
until one sunny morning, the turtle challenged him to a race.
All the forest neighbors lined up to watch,
and at three, two, one, they were off!
The rabbit zoomed miles ahead in seconds,
then looked back and saw nobody behind him.
With plenty of time to spare, he sat under a shady tree
and closed his eyes for just a quick nap.
Meanwhile, the little turtle just kept walking,
step after steady step, right past the sleeping rabbit.
By the time the rabbit woke up in shock,
the turtle was already crossing the finish line!
So remember, kids, slow and steady
beats fast and careless every single time.
